error_categories.description: The trace relies on direct chart-reading claims about percentage values and timestamps (e.g., Whole Foods cleanliness 80%, Walmart cleanliness 30%, Whole Foods value 15%, Walmart value 70%) without attributing them to any named tool result. In text-only verification, these media-grounded values are unsupported.

The question asks for the highest discrepancy among Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, and Albertsons, but the trace computes discrepancies only for Whole Foods and Walmart and omits Target and Albertsons entirely. Therefore the maximum is not established.

summary: The trace reaches a clear conclusion, but from text alone it is not justified: the key numeric chart values are unsupported media claims, and the required comparison across all four stores is incomplete.
